correctness.rationale: The pinned RESULT.md proves radial/angular factorization for differences of two independent uniform interior-ball points. The positive beta-integral c_{d,k} calibrates the radial moment, and squared spherical coordinates have Dirichlet(1/2,...,1/2) law. Consequently the moment series is product_i(1-a_i^2 t)^(-1/2), whose reciprocal square truncated at degree d recovers all axes including repeats. Invertible power-sum transformations and a Vandermonde Jacobian prove the generic lower cutoff; supplying volume fixes e_d, saving one moment. p_1^2/d <= p_2 < p_1^2 gives the two-moment range and endpoints. Independently checked the radial calibrations for dimensions 2 through 7 and source symbolic check_ellipsoid.py, rather than trusting its exit claim. No finite test is used to prove general d.
